STYLING
Introduce your family to ours.
Every family is unique. That’s why we offer so many different versions of Sienna. All told, there
are five models to choose from: L, LE, SE, XLE and Limited. There’s one thing, however, that all
Siennas have in common: the efficiency and power of a new 3.5-liter V6 direct-injection engine.
And for an added measure of confidence, you can go with available All-Wheel Drive (AWD).
XLE AWD shown in Predawn Gray Mica.
